audience: online store owners who check their products, reviews and shipping options in Putiikkipalvelu

useCases.title: Check the newest products and their stock
useCases.text: List the newest products with price, sale price, stock quantity and variations. Open one product by its slug for the full details.

useCases.title: Search a category or the whole store
useCases.text: Search products by text, or browse one category with sorting and paging. Count the products in a category.

useCases.title: Read the reviews of a product
useCases.text: Read the rating summary of a product, with the count per star, and its reviews.

useCases.title: Check the shipping options for a postal code
useCases.text: List the shipping methods and pickup locations for a postal code. Pass the cart total to see how the shipping threshold applies.

useCases.title: Read the store settings and content pages
useCases.text: Read the store name, contact details, currency and VAT rate. Read a content page, such as the terms, with its text.
